messages:
lucy: hey all, first-week question — where do I find the canonical engineering playbooks and the Notion templates? I wandered the spaces and got a few duplicates. also need edit access to update an oncall doc. any pointers? :wave:

devex: welcome lucy! :tada: our docs live in the "Redwood Docs" workspace. path is: Redwood Docs › Engineering › Playbooks and Redwood Docs › Engineering › Templates. quick links: https://redwood.notion.so/engineering-playbooks and https://redwood.notion.so/engineering-templates. for edit access we use a quick approval flow (see below). send the request in this channel or DM me and tag your manager.

jordan: yup — the playbooks folder has the canonical runbooks. fyi, we keep a 'latest' copy under Playbooks and archive older versions in Playbooks / archive. if you're editing oncall steps, please also add a small changelog block at the top like we do.

alex: @lucy — I approved edits for your team. just include me in the request message so we can track approvals. :+1:

lucy: thanks! what does the request look like? can I paste it here?

devex: you can copy this template and paste into a message. we prefer one message per page so the bot can pick it up:

```
Notion edit request
- page: Engineering Templates / Oncall Runbook
- reason: update steps for restart process after infra change
- manager: @alex
- urgency: low
```

we also have a short form if you want to submit via the access form: https://forms.redwood.com/notion-access (this auto-tags the devex team).

jordan: small tip — when editing templates, duplicate the template page and change the title to include your initials + date, then update. avoids accidental overwrite.

devex-bot: Access request received for page 'Engineering Templates / Oncall Runbook' from lucy. assigned to devex for approval.

devex: granted lucy edit access to Engineering Templates / Oncall Runbook. you should see the "Can edit" badge; if not, refresh Notion or DM me. :white_check_mark:

lucy: I can edit now, thanks so much! copied the template and added a short changelog. tagging @alex for visibility. :smile:

alex: saw the changelog — looks good. thanks for handling this, @lucy.

lucy: one last question — where are team-level templates vs org-level templates kept?

devex: org-level templates live in Redwood Docs › Templates. team-level (engineer-facing) are under Engineering › Templates. if you think a template should be promoted to org-level, open a quick PR-style comment in the template page and ping us.

lucy: perfect, note taken. appreciate the help! :heart:
